score_dimensions.question_specificity: 0 vague slogan; 1 bounded topic; 2 one answerable scientific question
score_dimensions.nontriviality: 0 guaranteed by complexity; 1 uncertain; 2 opposing explanations can both plausibly win
score_dimensions.experimental_discrimination: 0 same prediction; 1 partially different; 2 explicit mutually inconsistent outcomes
score_dimensions.local_feasibility: 0 unavailable resource; 1 uncertain or over budget; 2 executable locally within 30 minutes
score_dimensions.negative_result_value: 0 leaves decisions unchanged; 1 narrows implementation; 2 kills a direction or establishes a reusable boundary

survival_rule: No fatal flaw, total score at least 8, and experimental_discrimination equal to 2.
